title: 人民币年内升值4%：亚洲货币领跑，年底目标6.62
speaker: Xiaojiu

segments.en: The Remembe though remains very strong. How much more upside do you think we could see?
segments.zh: 人民币依然非常强势，您认为还有多少升值空间？

segments.en: I think we continue to expect the gradual appreciation of the CNY, especially if the US dollar would be on a path for more moderate weakening ahead.
segments.zh: 我们预计人民币将继续渐进升值，尤其是如果美元未来温和走弱。

segments.en: If we look at the sofa this year, CNY has definitely been a clear out performer in Asia, so far has already gained 4 percent against the US dollar.
segments.zh: 从今年表现看，人民币在亚洲货币中明显领先，对美元已升值4%。

segments.en: So we are targeting year-end and 6.62, so it's another 1.4 percent gain against the US dollar.
segments.zh: 我们预计年底人民币对美元汇率在6.62左右，意味着还有1.4%的升值空间。

segments.en: There have been a lot of debate about China's CNY's valuation and various estimates by the Western countries or these international institutions, supported CNY as an evaluation of 15 or even 30 percent.
segments.zh: 关于人民币估值存在很多争论，西方国家和国际机构估计人民币被低估15%甚至30%。

segments.en: Do they make sense to you? I think if we look at the midterm fundamentals, I think CNY really has a more room to gain.
segments.zh: 您认为这些说法合理吗？从中期基本面看，人民币确实还有升值空间。
